title: Aurebesh - Star Wars Font
description: The script/font used in the Star Wars universe in place of the Latin alphabet, now in Minecraft!
body:
The script/font used in the Star Wars universe in place of the Latin alphabet, now in Minecraft! Only changes characters that have an Aurebesh equivalent.
Since Aurebesh has some characters that are usually two letters in written English, I've replaced some of the otherwise-unused punctuation with the 8 additional characters. To write them, check the chart below.


- Cherek [​ch]: #
- Enth [​ae]: &
- Onith [​eo]: *
- Krenth [​kh]: +
- Nen [​ng]: =
- Orenth [​oo]: ^
- Shen [​sh]: `
- Thesh [​th]: ~

I did the best I could to update the `en_us` lang file to use the above ligatures, too.
Enjoy the pack!
